mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SUPPLIER_INFO (SUP_NAME, SUP_TEL, SUP_MANAGER_NAME, SUP_MANAGER_TEL, SUP_STATUS) VALUES (#{supName}, #{supTel}, #{supManagerName}, #{supManagerTel}, 1)
